extension.summary: Control Govee lights from inside Kodi
extension.description: Paragon Govee is part of the Paragon TV project. It replaces the Govee desktop and phone apps for day-to-day use by controlling your lights directly from Kodi.[CR][CR]Lights are driven over the Govee LAN API (UDP, no internet round-trip, no rate limit) whenever LAN Control is enabled on the device, and fall back to the Govee Cloud API when it is not. Power, brightness, RGB colour and colour temperature are all supported, along with named scenes you can build and re-use.[CR][CR]An optional background service syncs your lights to playback: dim when something starts, come part-way up on pause, and restore when playback stops. Every action is also reachable through RunScript() so it can be bound to a remote button or saved as a favourite.
extension.news: v1.2.0[CR]Colour entry now accepts the 8-digit hex codes the Govee app uses, and says how it read them.[CR][CR]v1.1.4[CR]New Check status reporting test: drives one bulb to a known colour and reads it back, to prove whether the model reports its state honestly.[CR][CR]v1.1.3[CR]A coloured bulb is no longer captured as white when a stale colour temperature sits beside it.[CR][CR]v1.1.2[CR]Capture fixes: brightness scale detection, no more long hang when bulbs are slow, and it now reports what it read.[CR][CR]v1.1.1[CR]Capture is now on the main menu, and the menu title shows the running version.[CR][CR]v1.1.0[CR]Capture the lights' current state as a scene - the way to bring a Govee Tap-to-Run into Kodi.[CR]Scenes can now hold a different setting per light.[CR][CR]v1.0.2[CR]LAN search now probes every network interface and falls back to broadcast.[CR]Added a Diagnose LAN search tool that says why a search found nothing.[CR][CR]v1.0.1[CR]Fixed the background service failing to start on Kodi 17.6 with "TypeError: an integer is required".[CR][CR]v1.0.0[CR]First release.[CR]LAN and Cloud transports with automatic per-device selection.[CR]Power, brightness, colour and colour temperature control.[CR]User-editable scenes.[CR]Playback-reactive lighting service.[CR]RunScript() actions for keymaps and favourites.
